the_thesis.title: Constrained Evolution: How Environmental Pressure Drives Convergence in Biological and Computational Systems
the_thesis.core_insight: The constraint IS the problem, not a speed modifier on a fixed problem. Thermus aquaticus did not converge on a universally better polymerase — it converged on the polymerase fit for 80°C. E. coli would never produce Taq given infinite time, because its fitness landscape does not reward thermostability.
biological_evidence: Thermus aquaticus and Taq polymerase — constraint defines fitness landscape
Lenski LTEE — ALL 12 populations got fitter, only 1 evolved citrate metabolism
Rika Anderson — population genomics of extremophiles in Yellowstone and deep-sea subsurface
computational_evidence: Rust type system as environmental constraint — borrow checker shapes what 'fit' means
2.1M lines of Rust across 473 crates — the constraint drove the architecture
16 primals compiled without unsafe — the constraint IS the membrane
